executive_verdict.primary_failure_mode: untrusted observations or model output must not become authority
executive_verdict.most_urgent_fix: enforced request schema, scope and authority gates implemented

findings.title: Source/model text becoming instructions
findings.mechanism: Model output is returned as unverified text; no tool-dispatch or automatic memory admission; imported content remains data.

findings.title: Context or grants surviving outside authorized scope
findings.mechanism: Owner binding, source/domain/context TTL, ephemeral sessions and recipe adoption; no grants restored by export.

findings.title: Concurrent local model loading
findings.mechanism: Expiring atomic lease in the existing Vault; one generation per home/namespace. No OS-wide memory quota is claimed.

findings.title: Disk admission could prevent stop
findings.mechanism: Volatile emergency stop is immediate even if metadata persistence fails; result exposes persisted=false.

findings.title: External local-server lifecycle
findings.mechanism: The Core cannot unload or cancel work inside a host-managed HTTP server. Default is disabled; GGUF one-shot is owned and terminated by the Core.

findings.title: Observations are not universal secret redaction
findings.mechanism: Typed scalar limits, rejected private observations, recognized sensitive keys and no automatic disclosure to LLMs. Trusted host must minimize raw data.
